text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: Streaming p99 tail latency SLO breached in eu-west-2 (p99 > 1200ms, p95 spiked). Automated alert at 2025-11-22T14:21:??Z. Trigger: streaming/response_time.p99 > 1200ms for 5m.
Oncall (Alex K.): acked — I'm on it. tagging networks + infra.
Maria S.: seeing matching telemetry on dashboard — streaming stalls increased ~3x, connection reset count up. p95 ~450ms, p99 ~1.4s right now.
Devon R.: logs show a bunch of TLS handshake retransmits and ECONNRESET on the streaming proxy in eu-west-2a. sample: `TLS handshake failed: read: connection reset by peer` repeated.
Jules L. (networks): I can start checking NAT/egress paths. any recent deploys?
Harper T. (prod): no deploys to streaming or edge in the last 30m, CI shows green.
Oncall (Alex K.): ok Devon — can you run a quick tcpdump from one of the proxy hosts and paste a short capture? also `ss -s` output.
Devon R.: running now — output looks like lots of TIME_WAIT / ephemeral-ports exhaustion on nat-proxies. `ss -s` shows high sockets in TIME_WAIT and orphaned connections.
Devon R.: tcpdump snippet:
```
12:21:10.123456 IP proxy1 > client: Flags [S], seq 0, win 64240, options [mss 1460,sackOK,TS val 12345 ecr 0,nop,wscale 7], length 0
12:21:10.124000 IP client > proxy1: RST, seq 1, length 0
12:21:10.125000 IP proxy1 > backend: TLS ClientHello
12:21:10.130000 IP backend > proxy1: retransmit TLS ServerHello (retransmitted)
```
Jules L. (networks): that pattern + high TIME_WAIT screams NAT ephemeral depletion or conntrack GC pressure. Are we hitting NAT gateway SNAT port limits in that AZ?
Maria S.: checking cloud metrics — SNAT ephemeral port exhaustion alarms firing for eu-west-2a nat-gw-3. High ephemeral usage correlates with streaming traffic bursts.
Jules L. (networks): can we divert traffic to eu-west-2b / 2c while we remediate? we have cross-zone routing available for streaming via the edge-router pool.
Oncall (Alex K.): yes please, do reroute. Devon, open a temporary route rule to prefer 2b/2c. Also increase conntrack table and kick GC.
Jules L. (networks): applying policy now — `edge-router set preference region=eu-west-2b,eu-west-2c weight=0.9` -> pushing.
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Edge routing policy update applied (change-id: cr-20251122-0923).
Devon R.: bumping conntrack on proxies: `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=2000000` and `echo 300 > /proc/sys/net/netfilter/nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_close_wait` — restarting nat-proxy process gracefully.
Harper T. (prod): scaling nat-gw-3 to add an extra instance and increasing SNAT capacity (cloud console action queued).
Maria S.: after reroute p95 dropped from 450ms -> 180ms in ~90s; p99 trending down from 1.4s -> 320ms. stalls count decreasing.
Jules L. (networks): SNAT usage on nat-gw-3 now 73% and trending down after scale + reroute. conntrack GC cycles reduced.
Oncall (Alex K.): good. keep monitoring for 15m. Maria, can you post customer impact estimate?
Maria S.: initial estimate: about 1.8% of active streaming sessions experienced stalls/short disconnects for ~2-6s. No full session drops recorded in the last 15m. A small subset of long-lived connections saw degraded tail latency.
Devon R.: kept a sample trace — many clients recovered via client reconnect/backoff. We did see a handful of retries that hit 429s from proxy while ephemeral ports were exhausted.
Harper T. (prod): posting status update to status page draft: "Investigating elevated streaming latency in eu-west-2. Mitigation in progress — traffic being routed to additional AZs. No widespread session loss."
Oncall (Alex K.): thanks. @Jules @Devon please keep the reroute for now; we'll move to a permanent SNAT capacity increase in the next maintenance window. Also add an automated alert for NAT ephemeral utilization.
Jules L. (networks): will follow up with an infra ticket to increase SNAT pool and add guardrails. ticket: INFRA-5928.
ops-bot: :information_source: Incident auto-summary: Root cause likely SNAT ephemeral port exhaustion + conntrack pressure causing TLS handshake retransmits and resets; mitigation: edge reroute to other AZs, conntrack bump, NAT scale.
Oncall (Alex K.): marking as mitigated for paging — continuing monitoring. Will handoff to networks/infra for next steps and permanent fix.
Maria S.: will monitor and post 1h follow-up with graphs. p99 back within SLO (currently 280ms).
Oncall (Alex K.): great work team, thumbs. I'll close the pager now and add notes to incident doc. :thumbsup:
